en.name: Oats, whole grain
en.summary: Whole grain oats — groats, and the steel-cut oats made from them — keep about 4 months in a sealed container in the cupboard and 8 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). Oats are among the oiliest of the common grains, and the oil is what sets the limit.
en.pantry: Keep them airtight in a cool, dark, dry cupboard and use them within about 4 months. Oats carry more fat than wheat or rice, which is why oatmeal tastes rich and why it goes rancid comparatively quickly — the bitterness of stale oats is unmistakable once you have met it. Commercial rolled oats are steamed during processing, which knocks out the enzyme that would otherwise accelerate that, but the fat is still there. Buy the size of bag you will get through and keep it away from the hob.
en.fridge: No refrigerator timeline is published for whole oats, so none is given here. The fridge is nonetheless a reasonable place for an opened bag in a warm, humid kitchen, since cold slows the oil from turning — the container must seal properly, because oats readily take up smells, and a cold jar opened in a warm room collects condensation on the grain. Let it come up to room temperature before opening it.
en.freezer: The freezer doubles it to about 8 months at −18 °C (0 °F) in an airtight container or a heavy bag with the air pressed out. This is the sensible answer for a bulk bag, and it deals with pantry moths at the same time — oats are one of their favourite targets. Freezing slows rancidity but does not reverse it, so freeze on the day you buy rather than once the bag smells suspect. Cook straight from frozen.
spoilage: A bitter, soapy or paint-like smell — rancid oat oil, and the usual end of a bag.
A musty or damp smell, or clumping in what should be loose grain.
Webbing, small moths, larvae or fine dust in the container.
Porridge that tastes bitter however it is sweetened.
tips: Buy small bags; four months is short if you only make porridge at weekends.
Freeze a bulk bag on the day of purchase.
Smell the dry oats before cooking; rancidity does not show.
Keep oats away from the stove — heat turns the fat faster than time does.

faq.q: How long do whole oats keep?
faq.a: About 4 months airtight in a cool, dark cupboard, or 8 months at −18 °C (0 °F).
They carry more fat than most grains, and fat oxidises. That is also why stale oats taste bitter rather than simply flat.
Yes, about 8 months at −18 °C in an airtight container, and it deals with pantry moths too.

zh.name: 全粒燕麥
zh.summary: 全粒燕麥——燕麥粒，以及由它切成的鋼切燕麥——密封放櫥櫃約 4 個月，−18 °C 冷凍 8 個月。燕麥是常見穀物裡油脂偏高的一種，而油脂就是它的期限所在。
zh.pantry: 密封放陰涼、避光、乾燥的櫥櫃，約 4 個月內用完。燕麥的脂肪含量高於小麥和稻米，這是燕麥粥吃起來濃郁的原因，也是它相對容易走油耗的原因——走味燕麥的那股苦，只要嘗過一次就忘不了。市售壓片燕麥在加工時經過蒸汽處理，破壞了會加速這件事的酵素，但油脂本身還在。請買你消耗得完的份量，並遠離爐台。
zh.fridge: 全粒燕麥沒有公布的冷藏期限，本頁也不給。不過在溫暖潮濕的廚房裡，開封後的袋子放冰箱仍然合理，因為低溫能延緩油脂變質——容器必須確實密封，因為燕麥很會吸味道，而冰冷的罐子在溫暖房間打開會在穀粒上結露。開封前先讓它回到室溫。
zh.freezer: 冷凍讓時間加倍，−18 °C 下約 8 個月，裝密封容器或厚袋壓出空氣。大包裝就該這樣做，同時也解決穀蛾——燕麥是牠們最愛的目標之一。冷凍能延緩油耗卻無法逆轉，所以要凍就買回來當天凍，不要等到袋子聞起來怪怪的才凍。要煮直接從冷凍下鍋。
spoilage: 聞到苦味、肥皂味或油漆味——燕麥油走油耗，也是一袋燕麥最常見的結局。
有潮霉味，或本該鬆散的麥粒結塊。
容器內出現絲網、小蛾、幼蟲或細粉屑。
煮成的粥不管加多少糖都帶苦味。
tips: 買小包；如果只有週末煮粥，四個月其實很短。
大包裝買回來當天就冷凍。
煮之前先聞乾燕麥；油耗是看不出來的。
遠離爐火——高溫讓油脂變質的速度比時間還快。

faq.a: 密封、陰涼避光的櫥櫃約 4 個月，或 −18 °C 冷凍 8 個月。
它的脂肪含量比大多數穀物高，而脂肪會氧化。這也是走味燕麥會發苦、而不只是變淡的原因。
可以，−18 °C 下密封容器約 8 個月，還能順便解決穀蛾。
